preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 10**6 for n, q in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of cities n is between 3 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= q <= n for n, q in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the subset size q is between 3 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= (n * (n - 1)) // 2 for result, (n, q) in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is the minimum number of roads to demolish, which is between 0 and the total number of roads in the complete graph.

postconditions.expression: all(result == (n * (n - 1)) // 2 - (q * (q - 1)) // 2 for result, (n, q) in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is the minimum number of roads to demolish, calculated as the total number of roads minus the number of roads in a complete subgraph of size q.
